newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 1996 INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT ROSE 3 PCT -SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 1996 INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT ROSE 3 PCT -SF.

text.p: The value of industrial production rose three percent in 1996, according to preliminary data, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Monday.
It said growth slowed, but gave no comparison from 1995, and an official said there was no fully comparable 1995 data.
"The value of production rose just three percent," SF said, but did not give the absolute figures.
"Industrial output growth relied heavily on the metal industry where the value of production increased by seven percent," it said.
Exports fuelled growth in almost all main sectors, SF said, but the value added fell in most industries, with a four percent decline overall.
"Export growth was especially strong in the electrical industry, where export deliveries rose 21 percent" it said.
